firstPlayerRule: Shake the players’ rooster tokens in your hand and randomly pick one. That player is first and takes the first player token.
clarifications: Starting choices on the blue cards are made clockwise starting with the first player.
Each spring, starting with the first player and going clockwise, players place roosters on the wake-up chart, which sets turn order for the rest of the year.
At the end of each year, the first player token rotates counter-clockwise.
